flag_rule.text: a case regresses when it fails at least 2 of its 3 runs and passed every one of its 3 baseline runs that did not error; it improves when it passes at least 2 of 3 and failed every one of its 3 baseline runs that did not error

paired_test.correction: Holm across the per-dataset tests, which controls the chance of any false positive among them; the overall test is the primary one and is not adjusted, so across every row that chance can reach twice alpha
